notifyNoticeText: {LMA_USER} is using Live Meeting Assistant to record and transcribe this meeting ({meeting}). If you do not agree, reply "{objection_phrase}" in the chat or say so, and recording and transcription will stop.
optInNoticeText: {LMA_USER} would like to record and transcribe this meeting ({meeting}) with Live Meeting Assistant. Nothing is recorded or transcribed until everyone has agreed. Reply "{consent_phrase}" to agree, or "{objection_phrase}" to decline.
consentPhrases: I consent, I agree, I accept
objectionPhrases: I object, I do not consent, I don't consent, I do not agree, I don't agree, do not record, don't record, stop recording
